body_query_precision.reason: How much of the distinct body vocabulary belongs to the question?

body_query_dice.reason: How similar are the question and body word sets, accounting for both lengths?

body_query_saturated_tf.reason: How often do question words appear in body, with diminishing credit for repeats?

body_query_bigram.reason: What fraction of adjacent question-word pairs appear together in body?

title_query_precision.reason: How much of the distinct title vocabulary belongs to the question?

title_query_dice.reason: How similar are the question and title word sets, accounting for both lengths?

title_query_saturated_tf.reason: How often do question words appear in title, with diminishing credit for repeats?

title_query_bigram.reason: What fraction of adjacent question-word pairs appear together in title?

description_query_precision.reason: How much of the distinct description vocabulary belongs to the question?

description_query_dice.reason: How similar are the question and description word sets, accounting for both lengths?

description_query_saturated_tf.reason: How often do question words appear in description, with diminishing credit for repeats?

description_query_bigram.reason: What fraction of adjacent question-word pairs appear together in description?

path_query_precision.reason: How much of the distinct path vocabulary belongs to the question?

path_query_dice.reason: How similar are the question and path word sets, accounting for both lengths?

path_query_saturated_tf.reason: How often do question words appear in path, with diminishing credit for repeats?

path_query_bigram.reason: What fraction of adjacent question-word pairs appear together in path?

headings_query_precision.reason: How much of the distinct headings vocabulary belongs to the question?

headings_query_dice.reason: How similar are the question and headings word sets, accounting for both lengths?

headings_query_saturated_tf.reason: How often do question words appear in headings, with diminishing credit for repeats?

headings_query_bigram.reason: What fraction of adjacent question-word pairs appear together in headings?

section_coverage_fraction_0_5.reason: What fraction of sections cover at least 50% of question words?

section_coverage_fraction_0_8.reason: What fraction of sections cover at least 80% of question words?

section_coverage_fraction_1_0.reason: What fraction of sections cover at least 100% of question words?

section_coverage_std.reason: Is question coverage spread evenly across sections or concentrated in a few?

top_three_section_coverage.reason: How well do the three best sections cover the question?

best_section_log_words.reason: How long is the section that best matches the question? The section is selected by prompt coverage.

first_query_match_position.reason: How far into the page is the first question word?

query_match_density.reason: What fraction of page words match the question?

paragraph_log_median_words.reason: How long is a typical paragraph?

paragraph_log_p90_words.reason: How long are the longer paragraphs?

short_paragraph_fraction.reason: How many paragraphs are short, readable chunks of 10 to 60 words?

unique_word_fraction.reason: How much vocabulary variety does the page have? This also depends on length.

numeric_word_fraction.reason: How often does the page include numbers?

question_heading_fraction.reason: How many headings are written as questions?

log_link_count.reason: How many links appear in retained blocks?

links_per_1000_words.reason: How link-heavy is the page relative to its length?

heading_word_fraction.reason: How much retained text is inside heading blocks?

paragraph_word_fraction.reason: How much retained text is inside paragraph blocks?

list_item_word_fraction.reason: How much retained text is inside list item blocks?

table_word_fraction.reason: How much retained text is inside table blocks?

code_word_fraction.reason: How much retained text is inside code blocks?

answer_best_sentence_coverage.reason: How much of the question appears together in one 6–80-word sentence?

answer_top3_sentence_coverage.reason: How much question coverage do the three best distinct sentences provide?

answer_relevant_sentence_fraction.reason: What fraction of distinct sentences cover at least half the meaningful question words?

answer_log_relevant_sentences.reason: How many distinct question-relevant sentences are available? Large counts are squeezed.

answer_best_sentence_precision.reason: How focused is the most question-dense sentence?

answer_relevant_median_words.reason: How long is a typical relevant sentence?

answer_window_10_coverage.reason: How much of the question occurs within a 10-word prose window?

answer_window_25_coverage.reason: How much of the question occurs within a 25-word prose window?

answer_window_50_coverage.reason: How much of the question occurs within a 50-word prose window?

answer_relevant_union_coverage.reason: Together, how much of the question do relevant distinct sentences cover?

evidence_number_fraction.reason: What fraction of relevant sentences contain a number cue? This does not verify truth. Relevant sentences are selected using the prompt, so this is a joint feature.

evidence_number_coverage.reason: How well does the best relevant sentence with a number cue cover the question? Relevant sentences are selected using the prompt, so this is a joint feature.

evidence_unit_fraction.reason: What fraction of relevant sentences contain a unit cue? This does not verify truth. Relevant sentences are selected using the prompt, so this is a joint feature.

evidence_unit_coverage.reason: How well does the best relevant sentence with a unit cue cover the question? Relevant sentences are selected using the prompt, so this is a joint feature.

evidence_definition_fraction.reason: What fraction of relevant sentences contain a definition cue? This does not verify truth. Relevant sentences are selected using the prompt, so this is a joint feature.

evidence_definition_coverage.reason: How well does the best relevant sentence with a definition cue cover the question? Relevant sentences are selected using the prompt, so this is a joint feature.

evidence_linked_fraction.reason: How often are relevant sentences inside a block with a link? A link need not be a trustworthy citation. Relevant sentences are selected using the prompt, so this is a joint feature.

evidence_numeric_intent_alignment.reason: For a numeric question, does a relevant sentence contain a number? Relevant sentences are selected using the prompt, so this is a joint feature.

evidence_definition_intent_alignment.reason: For a definition or explanation question, does relevant prose use an explanation cue? Relevant sentences are selected using the prompt, so this is a joint feature.

table_best_value_row_coverage.reason: How well does one table data row cover the question, excluding header cells?

table_top3_value_row_coverage.reason: How well do the three best distinct table data rows match?

table_relevant_row_fraction.reason: What fraction of distinct table data rows cover half the question?

table_numeric_row_coverage.reason: How well does a table data row containing numbers match the question?

table_header_best_coverage.reason: What is the best question match within the headers of one table?

table_numeric_intent_alignment.reason: For numeric questions, how relevant is the best numeric table row?

steps_best_coverage.reason: How well does one distinct numbered step match the question?

steps_relevant_fraction.reason: What fraction of distinct numbered steps cover half the question?

steps_howto_alignment.reason: For how-to questions, is there a matching numbered step?

supported_coverage_title.reason: coverage_title multiplied by best answer-sentence coverage: metadata gets lexical credit only when prose also matches. Body support may change even when the URL stays fixed.

supported_title_query_precision.reason: title_query_precision multiplied by best answer-sentence coverage: metadata gets lexical credit only when prose also matches. Body support may change even when the URL stays fixed.

supported_title_query_dice.reason: title_query_dice multiplied by best answer-sentence coverage: metadata gets lexical credit only when prose also matches. Body support may change even when the URL stays fixed.

supported_title_query_saturated_tf.reason: title_query_saturated_tf multiplied by best answer-sentence coverage: metadata gets lexical credit only when prose also matches. Body support may change even when the URL stays fixed.

supported_title_query_bigram.reason: title_query_bigram multiplied by best answer-sentence coverage: metadata gets lexical credit only when prose also matches. Body support may change even when the URL stays fixed.

supported_path_query_precision.reason: path_query_precision multiplied by best answer-sentence coverage: metadata gets lexical credit only when prose also matches. Body support may change even when the URL stays fixed.

supported_path_query_dice.reason: path_query_dice multiplied by best answer-sentence coverage: metadata gets lexical credit only when prose also matches. Body support may change even when the URL stays fixed.

supported_path_query_saturated_tf.reason: path_query_saturated_tf multiplied by best answer-sentence coverage: metadata gets lexical credit only when prose also matches. Body support may change even when the URL stays fixed.

supported_path_query_bigram.reason: path_query_bigram multiplied by best answer-sentence coverage: metadata gets lexical credit only when prose also matches. Body support may change even when the URL stays fixed.

long_window_10_best.reason: Best question coverage inside a 10-word window in prose segments longer than 80 tokens.

long_window_10_mean.reason: Average best 10-word question coverage across distinct long prose segments; exact repetition receives no extra count.

long_window_25_best.reason: Best question coverage inside a 25-word window in prose segments longer than 80 tokens.

long_window_25_mean.reason: Average best 25-word question coverage across distinct long prose segments; exact repetition receives no extra count.

long_window_50_best.reason: Best question coverage inside a 50-word window in prose segments longer than 80 tokens.

long_window_50_mean.reason: Average best 50-word question coverage across distinct long prose segments; exact repetition receives no extra count.

normalized_title_coverage.reason: Question-word coverage in title after fixed plural, spelling, unit and number normalization.

normalized_title_gain.reason: Change in title coverage from lexical normalization; may be negative when normalization changes token sets.

normalized_path_coverage.reason: Question-word coverage in path after fixed plural, spelling, unit and number normalization.

normalized_path_gain.reason: Change in path coverage from lexical normalization; may be negative when normalization changes token sets.

normalized_body_coverage.reason: Question-word coverage in body after fixed plural, spelling, unit and number normalization.

normalized_body_gain.reason: Change in body coverage from lexical normalization; may be negative when normalization changes token sets.

normalized_prose_window_10.reason: Best 10-word prose coverage after normalization, using the same 6–80-token sentence eligibility as v5.

normalized_prose_window_25.reason: Best 25-word prose coverage after normalization, using the same 6–80-token sentence eligibility as v5.

normalized_number_coverage.reason: Do the explicit numbers in the question appear in the body after numeric-format normalization? Units are not converted.

supported_normalized_title_coverage.reason: normalized_title_coverage multiplied by prose support, keeping combined metadata corroboration intact. Body support may change even when the URL stays fixed.

supported_normalized_title_gain.reason: normalized_title_gain multiplied by prose support, keeping combined metadata corroboration intact. Body support may change even when the URL stays fixed.

supported_normalized_path_coverage.reason: normalized_path_coverage multiplied by prose support, keeping combined metadata corroboration intact. Body support may change even when the URL stays fixed.

supported_normalized_path_gain.reason: normalized_path_gain multiplied by prose support, keeping combined metadata corroboration intact. Body support may change even when the URL stays fixed.
